tools.name: scheduler
tools.description:
Create, edit, list, or cancel one-time or recurring cron tasks in this room/thread.
- `create`: needs `message`, `new_thread`, and one timing field (`execute_at`/`delay_seconds`/`cron`). Supports `@agent`/`@team`, fresh threads, silent monitors (`NO_REPLY`), and per-run `model`.
- `edit`: patch by `task_id` (omitted unchanged; no one-time <-> cron switch; <=1 timing field; `new_thread` immutable; empty `model` resets; `clear_history_limit=True` restores unlimited history).
- `list` / `cancel`: list pending tasks or cancel by `task_id` (no other params).

message.description: Trigger text (`create` required); include `@agent`/`@team` to mention responders.

new_thread.description: `create` required: `False` = current room/thread, `True` = fresh thread per fire (with `silent=True`, findings/failures post as a room-level root).

execute_at.description: Future ISO 8601 datetime with time (or naive in `timezone`; pass offset during DST).

cron.description: 5-field cron (`min hour day month weekday`) in `timezone`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (default: agent timezone; legacy UTC cron edit also needs `cron`).

history_limit.description: Max thread messages per fire (`0` = none; unset = unlimited).

clear_history_limit.description: `edit` only: set `True` to remove the history limit (unlimited).

silent.description: Hidden trigger; suppress empty, whitespace, or `NO_REPLY`-ending finals while findings/failures/tool messages stay visible (defaults to `False` on `create`).

model.description: Per-run model alias or `name@level` (pass an empty string on `edit` to reset to default; conversation model unchanged).

mindroom_output_path.description: Optional workspace-relative path: save full supported output to file and return a receipt.

tools.name: skill
tools.description:
Load a skill's instructions, reference document, or script without running it.
- `instructions`: load a skill's `SKILL.md` instructions and list its available `references/` and `scripts/` files (`path` must be omitted).
- `reference`: load one listed reference document (`path` required).
- `script`: read one listed script without running it; run scripts with shell if available (`path` required).

path.description: Listed filename under `references/` or `scripts/` (required for `reference` and `script`; omit for `instructions`).

mindroom_output_path.description: Optional workspace-relative path: save full supported output to file and return a receipt.

n.description: (float) Number to calculate the square root of.

mindroom_output_path.description: Optional workspace-relative path: save full supported output to file and return a receipt.
